soil_groups.name: Histosols
soil_groups.description: Soils with thick organic layers

soil_groups.name: Anthrosols
soil_groups.description: Soils with strong human influence - With long and intensive agricultural use:

soil_groups.name: Technosols
soil_groups.description: Soils with strong human influence - AT Containing significant amounts of artefacts:

soil_groups.name: Cryosols
soil_groups.description: Soils with limitations to root growth - Permafrost affected

soil_groups.name: Leptosols
soil_groups.description: Soils with limitations to root growth - Thin or with many coarse fragments

soil_groups.name: Solonetz
soil_groups.description: Soils with limitations to root growth - With a high content of exchangeable Na

soil_groups.name: Vertisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with limitations to root growth - Alternating wet-dry conditions, shrink-swell clays

soil_groups.name: Solonchaks
soil_groups.description: Soils with limitations to root growth - High concentration of soluble salts

soil_groups.name: Greysols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Groundwater-affected, underwater and in tidal areas

soil_groups.name: Andosols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Allophanes or Al-humus complexes

soil_groups.name: Podzols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Subsoil accumulation of humus and/or oxides

soil_groups.name: Plinthosols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Accumulation and redistribution of Fe

soil_groups.name: Nitisols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Low-activity clay, P fixation, many Fe oxides, strongly structured

soil_groups.name: Ferralsols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Dominance of kaolinite and oxides

soil_groups.name: Planasols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Stagnating water, abrupt textural difference

soil_groups.name: Stagnosols
soil_groups.description: Soils distinguished by Fe/Al chemistry - Stagnating water, structural difference and/or moderate textural difference

soil_groups.name: Chernozems
soil_groups.description: Pronounced accumulation of organic matter in the mineral topsoil - Very dark topsoil, secondary carbonates

soil_groups.name: Kastanozems
soil_groups.description: Pronounced accumulation of organic matter in the mineral topsoil - Dark topsoil, secondary carbonates

soil_groups.name: Phaeozems
soil_groups.description: Pronounced accumulation of organic matter in the mineral topsoil - Dark topsoil, no secondary carbonates (unless very deep), high base status

soil_groups.name: Umbrisols
soil_groups.description: Pronounced accumulation of organic matter in the mineral topsoil - Dark topsoil, low base status

soil_groups.name: Durisols
soil_groups.description: Accumulation of moderately soluble salts or non-saline substances - Accumulation of and cementation by secondary silica

soil_groups.name: Gypsisols
soil_groups.description: Accumulation of moderately soluble salts or non-saline substances - Accumulation of secondary gypsum

soil_groups.name: Calcisols
soil_groups.description: Accumulation of moderately soluble salts or non-saline substances - Accumulation of secondary carbonates

soil_groups.name: Retisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with clay-enriched subsoil - Interfingering of coarser-textured, lighter coloured material into a finer-textured, stronger coloured layer

soil_groups.name: Acrisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with clay-enriched subsoil - Low-activity clays, low base status

soil_groups.name: Lixisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with clay-enriched subsoil - Low-activity clays, high base status

soil_groups.name: Alisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with clay-enriched subsoil - High-activity clays, low base status

soil_groups.name: Luvisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with clay-enriched subsoil - High-activity clays, high base status

soil_groups.name: Cambisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with little or no profile differentiation - Moderately developed

soil_groups.name: Arenosols
soil_groups.description: Soils with little or no profile differentiation - Sandy

soil_groups.name: Fluvisols
soil_groups.description: Soils with little or no profile differentiation - Stratified fluviatile, marine and lacustrine sediments

soil_groups.name: Regosols
soil_groups.description: Soils with little or no profile differentiation - No significant profile development
